div.head: Wif 5
div.ab: Trymme he eal mid wedde þæt þæt he behate; 7 aborgian frynd þæt.
Totum hoc uadio confirmetur; et amici sui plegient.
Trymme he eal mid wedde þæt þæt he behate; 7 aborgian frynd þæt.
He is to strengthen all that he promises with a pledge, and his friends are to stand surety for it.
Jener [Bräutigam] bekräftige alles das, was er verheisst, durch Pfand; und [seine] Blutsfreunde sollen das verbürgen.
Let [the bridegroom] confirm with a pledge all that he promises; and let [his] blood-friends stand surety for it.
